## Notes

Ludum Dare 26 prototype April 2013 with free web version; alpha September 2013; Steam Early Access August 2014; PC 1.0 2015-11-06; mobile 2016, Switch 2018, PS4 2019. Stations overcrowd at about six passengers; weekly asset rewards; Normal, Extreme, Endless, Creative modes.
